textLeading:-4, font:SdfOldBold>萬能蘭迪的^屋簷排水槽^雨水收集指南<type:text, x:25, y:320, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.9, scaleX:0.4, scaleY:0.4, autoWidth:617.5, textLeading:3, font:SdfOldRegular>        任何稱職的農夫、牧場主或生存專家都明白，獨立自主的根基來自於水。有了萬能蘭迪與大自然母親的相助，您就能擺脫政府那摻雜化學物質的供水所帶來的束縛。立即入手一本《萬能蘭迪的屋簷排水槽雨水收集指南》，讓您的家人從此不再口渴。^        以下是萬能蘭迪傾囊相授的智慧小品嚐，全套只需分6期付款，每期19.99美元。您的未來值多少錢？<type:texture, width:170, height:2, x:75, y:530, pivotX:0, pivotY:0, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.5><type:text, x:25, y:550, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.9, scaleX:0.4, scaleY:0.4, autoWidth:617.5, textLeading:3, font:SdfOldItalic>試閱：第1章<type:text, x:25, textLeading:3, font:SdfOldRegular>        如果不知道排水槽是由什麼組成的，就別輕易相信自己的直覺（gut/gutter 諧音）：^^          一段暴露在外部環境中的^          屋頂或樓板^^          一根用來將屋頂段落的雨水^          引導下來的排水管^^          一個用來承接排水管^          流出雨水的收集容器<type:texture, texture:media/ui/FG_Fluid_Drop_Icon.png, width:24, height:24, x:25, y:655, a:0.65><type:texture, texture:media/ui/FG_Plumb_Icon.png, width:24, height:24, x:25, y:705, pivotY:0, scaleX:0.8, scaleY:0.8, textLeading:-4, font:SdfOldBold>既有^建築<type:text, x:305, y:265, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.9, scaleX:0.4, scaleY:0.4, autoWidth:542.5, textLeading:3, font:SdfOldRegular>        根據肯塔基州專制的建築法規，所有住宅與商業建築無論屋頂形狀或角度如何，都必須設置可正常運作的排水槽。^        這些強制設置的排水槽，讓任何既有建築都成為收集雨水的便利選擇，省去您爬上屋頂自行架設排水管的麻煩。有些建築的一樓可能已經有可使用的排水管，只需再配一個盛水容器就能完成整套系統。^        只要把收集容器放在排水管下方，再用管鉗快速轉幾下將兩者接起來即可。<type:text, x:305, y:575, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.9, pivotX:0, pivotY:0, scaleX:0.5, scaleY:0.5, textLeading:-4, font:SdfOldBold>沒有排水管？沒煩惱！<type:text, x:305, y:605, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.9, scaleX:0.4, scaleY:0.4, autoWidth:542.5, textLeading:3, font:SdfOldRegular>        如果找不到現成的排水管，業餘焊工也可以用幾塊廢金屬自己拼湊一根。不必好看，只要不漏水就行！^        垂直接上管子，把排水管延伸到足以通到屋頂周圍排水槽的樓層高度。務必讓這些管子與排水管對齊，並以牆壁支撐固定。<type:texture, width:3, height:605, x:535, y:185, pivotX:0, pivotY:0, r:0.3, g:0.3, b:0.3, a:0.5><type:text, x:550, y:180, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.9, scaleX:0.4, scaleY:0.4, autoWidth:550, textLeading:3, font:SdfOldItalic>試閱：第3章<type:text, x:550, y:200, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.9, pivotX:0, pivotY:0, scaleX:0.8, scaleY:0.8, textLeading:-4, font:SdfOldBold>自建^建築<type:text, x:550, y:265, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.9, scaleX:0.4, scaleY:0.4, autoWidth:550, textLeading:3, font:SdfOldRegular>        貪心的鄰居不肯借您屋頂？或者只是想遠離塵囂，在森林裡開闢屬於自己的天地？從自建建築收集雨水的流程，與既有建築幾乎一模一樣，只多一個步驟就能把一切串連起來。^        沒有那些惱人的政府法規對您指手畫腳，您得自行在屋頂外圍安裝排水管。只要有樓板或牆壁可以支撐，從上方或下方都可以安裝。^        小心腳下！一旦摔下去，口渴會是您最小的問題。<type:text, x:550, y:575, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.9, pivotX:0, pivotY:0, scaleX:0.5, scaleY:0.5, textLeading:-4, font:SdfOldBold>越大（通常）越好<type:text, x:550, y:605, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.9, scaleX:0.4, scaleY:0.4, autoWidth:542.5, textLeading:3, font:SdfOldRegular>        屋頂越大，可能性越高──但有其上限。所有排水管都有最大容量，超出的「溢流」部分收集效率會差得多。您可以增建額外的排水段落，充分利用大面積屋頂，但必須保持適當間隔，避免重複收集同一區域的雨水。大多數住宅只需1至2根排水管就足夠，較大的建築則可能需要3至4根甚至更多才能完整涵蓋。^        如果您的住家比較小，也不必氣餒。即使只是一座單車位車庫，也有足夠的空間讓雨水收集值得一試。<type:texture, width:3, height:75, x:25, y:800, pivotX:0, pivotY:0, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.75><type:texture, width:507, height:3, x:28, y:800, pivotX:0, Print_Media_MSC_CabinClimateGuide_info: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD XIV^車內空調<type:texture, x:100, y:200, texture:media/textures/MSC/printmedia_climate_640.png, width:600, height:300><type:text, x:105, y:540, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>車內空調與引擎息息相關。暖氣使用溫熱的冷卻液;冷氣則需要壓縮機和皮帶,因此舒適度可能會因為循環或附屬配件的問題而失效。<type:text, x:105, y:680, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲內<type:text, x:105, y:725, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>使用一般的暖氣與冷氣控制。暖氣必須具備溫熱、充足且乾淨的冷卻液,並搭配正常運作的暖氣芯、水泵和風扇皮帶才能運作;冷氣需要壓縮機和皮帶,且引擎轉速越高效果越強。即使引擎熄火,鼓風機仍會消耗電池電力。空調故障只會失去舒適度,不會影響駕駛能力。
Print_Media_MSC_ComponentClassesGuide_in: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD X^零件等級<type:text, x:105, y:260, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>標準、重型與運動屬於適配等級,並非逐級遞增的升級階梯。換用不同等級的零件或許能挽救一輛撿來的車,但之後會因相容性壓力而額外增加磨損。<type:text, x:105, y:460, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲內<type:text, x:105, y:510, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>安裝零件前請先確認其等級:標準、重型與運動屬於相容性等級,並非升級。等級相符時可保持預期的輸出表現。等級不符的零件仍可安裝,但會造成額外的磨損、發熱與油耗,並對相連系統施加壓力;診斷功能會回報此壓力。
Print_Media_MSC_CoolingSystemGuide_info: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD IV^冷卻系統<type:texture, x:100, y:200, texture:media/textures/MSC/printmedia_cooling_640.png, width:600, height:300><type:text, x:105, y:540, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>冷卻系統是一個完整的循環:散熱器儲存冷卻液,水泵負責循環,節溫器引導流向,風扇與皮帶則將熱量帶走。只有一個零件完好,救不了一個已經損壞的循環。<type:text, x:105, y:680, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲中<type:text, x:105, y:725, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>在「零件」中,請將散熱器、水泵、節溫器、風扇、水管與風扇皮帶視為一個冷卻循環來監控。冷卻液不足或受到污染、出現洩漏,或皮帶、水泵損壞,都會降低冷卻效果;過熱隨後會損傷引擎零件,甚至使引擎熄火。在負載駕駛前,請更換故障零件並補足正確的冷卻液。
Print_Media_MSC_DipstickQuickGuide_info: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD I^機油診斷<type:texture, x:100, y:200, texture:media/textures/MSC/printmedia_dipstick_sketch_640.png, width:600, height:300><type:text, x:105, y:540, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>機油尺能讓你在不拆解引擎的情況下,得知封閉引擎內部的狀況。它是一種診斷工具:機油的狀態會影響油壓以及內部零件的保護程度。<type:text, x:105, y:680, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲內<type:text, x:105, y:725, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>將機油尺放在物品欄中,然後開啟車輛機械並選擇「油液」。它會顯示機油的清潔度與新鮮度,以及冷卻液和變速箱油的品質;沒有機油尺時,油液的量與種類仍然可以看到。機油尺只能用來診斷,無法補充或清潔系統。
Print_Media_MSC_DrivingLoadGuide_info: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD XII^負載駕駛<type:text, x:105, y:260, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>過載並不只是開得快:當引擎長時間要求高功率,車輛卻沒有隨之加速時,就會發生過載。這會使容易受損的引擎與傳動系統零件發熱,並加速磨損。<type:text, x:105, y:460, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲內<type:text, x:105, y:510, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>當高轉速與油門全開卻無法產生加速時,請鬆開油門或重新提升車速。持續的拖滯、傳動系統打滑與重載會在短暫的寬限期後累積過載;過載會使引擎與傳動系統零件的發熱與磨損增加,直到恢復正常駕駛才會逐漸緩解。若已安裝 ECU,診斷功能中會標示出過載狀態。
Print_Media_MSC_ECUDiagnosticsGuide_info: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD XI^ECU 診斷<type:texture, x:100, y:200, texture:media/textures/MSC/printmedia_ecu_640.png, width:600, height:300><type:text, x:105, y:540, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>ECU 並不會修復車輛,它只是讓隱藏的模擬資料變得可讀,協助區分機油壓力、冷卻、牽引力與過載等不同成因。<type:text, x:105, y:680, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲內<type:text, x:105, y:725, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>在「零件 → 診斷」中,於引擎蓋開啟且引擎熄火的狀態下,從物品欄安裝一個車輛 ECU。這會解鎖診斷分頁,並以涵蓋所有油液品質與溫度的讀數取代手持式檢查。在挑選零件之前,可利用其即時的負面效果清單,區分機油壓力、冷卻、傳動系統、相容性與過載等成因。
Print_Media_MSC_EngineComponentsGuide_in: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD VI^引擎零件<type:texture, x:100, y:200, texture:media/textures/MSC/printmedia_engine_components_640.png, width:600, height:300><type:text, x:105, y:540, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>這是 MSC 的主要作業視窗:引擎由一組各自獨立的零件構成,每個零件都有自己的安裝與拆卸相依關係。此視窗會透過原版車輛機械選單開啟;若未自動開啟,也可以右鍵點擊引擎 → 檢查引擎零件作為額外途徑。<type:text, x:105, y:680, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲內操作<type:text, x:105, y:725, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>零件視窗會在開啟車輛機械選單並掀開引擎蓋時出現;只有在需要重新開啟時,才對引擎使用「檢查引擎零件」。右鍵點擊已安裝的零件即可拆下,或點擊空槽位來安裝隨身攜帶的零件。必須具備工具;機械技能只會影響成功率與損壞風險,並不會阻止作業,提示框會顯示所需工具、建議技能與拆卸順序。
Print_Media_MSC_EngineLiftGuide_info: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD VIII^工坊吊架<type:texture, x:100, y:200, texture:media/textures/MSC/printmedia_engine_lift_640.png, width:600, height:300><type:text, x:105, y:540, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>吊架的作用不只是加快作業速度:它能讓引擎變成可拆卸的總成,方便進行深度保養或換裝。這項特殊操作屬於「引擎」右鍵選單,而非一般的零件清單。<type:text, x:105, y:680, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲中<type:text, x:105, y:725, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>在完整的吊架旁,先熄火並打開引擎蓋,裝備扳手,然後右鍵點擊「引擎」→「從吊架上拆下引擎」或「從吊架上安裝引擎」。拆下後,同一個總成會被放在吊架上,可在交給另一輛車之前進行檢查與保養。空的引擎室會維持空著;跨系列換裝雖然可行,但會帶來相容性壓力。
Print_Media_MSC_RoadsideRepairGuide_info: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD III^路邊維修<type:texture, x:100, y:200, texture:media/textures/MSC/printmedia_roadside_repair_640.png, width:600, height:300><type:text, x:105, y:540, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>路邊維修只是讓你撐到抵達工坊的短暫緩解,並非徹底修復。膠帶、電線與工具只能用於三種零件,因此請謹慎使用此選項。<type:text, x:105, y:680, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲中<type:text, x:105, y:725, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>在引擎蓋開啟且引擎熄火的狀態下,對冷卻液軟管、風扇皮帶或點火線圈按右鍵 → 路邊維修。軟管需要膠帶和螺絲起子;皮帶需要扳手;線圈需要電線、膠帶和螺絲起子。維修效果是暫時的,上限為 60%,重複維修後效益會遞減;只有軟管能從 0% 狀態下挽救回來。
Print_Media_MSC_RoadsideServiceChecklist: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD II^油液保養<type:texture, x:100, y:200, texture:media/textures/MSC/printmedia_fluid_service_640.png, width:600, height:300><type:text, x:105, y:540, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>油液是需要保養的消耗資源:它們可能被排空、混合或受到污染。正確的液體能讓系統正常運作;錯誤的液體則會殘留在油槽中,破壞原有的混合液。<type:text, x:105, y:680, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲中<type:text, x:105, y:725, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>在零件視窗中,對油底殼、散熱器或變速箱按右鍵 → 管理油液。使用隨身攜帶的容器進行加注與排空;油液會互相混合,因此錯誤的液體會殘留在內部,並降低系統純淨度。自動變速箱需要使用 ATF,手動變速箱則需要使用手動變速箱油。
Print_Media_MSC_StartingChargingGuide_in: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD V^啟動與充電<type:texture, x:100, y:200, texture:media/textures/MSC/printmedia_starting_640.png, width:600, height:300><type:text, x:105, y:540, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>啟動與充電是兩件不同的事。電池與啟動馬達負責發動引擎;發電機與皮帶則在引擎運轉時回充電力。沒有發電機,車輛仍可啟動,但無法長時間供應用電負載。<type:text, x:105, y:680, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲中<type:text, x:105, y:725, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>在「零件」中,請分別檢查電池、啟動馬達、發電機與風扇皮帶。電池與啟動馬達負責帶動引擎轉動;發電機只有在皮帶轉動時才會充電。沒有發電機,車輛仍可啟動,但電池會在用電負載下耗盡,且當電量降到零時,運轉中的引擎就會熄火。
Print_Media_MSC_TransmissionSetupGuide_i: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD IX^變速箱設置<type:texture, x:100, y:200, texture:media/textures/MSC/printmedia_transmission_640.png, width:600, height:300><type:text, x:105, y:540, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>變速箱必須透過相配的聯軸機構才能傳遞動力。自動與手動系統都是完整的成對組合,而非可隨意互換的零散零件:配對錯誤時,引擎雖然能運轉,車輪卻得不到任何動力。<type:text, x:105, y:680, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲中<type:text, x:105, y:725, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>在「零件」中右鍵點擊「變速箱」或「動力聯軸器」。更改配置前,請先拆下變速箱與舊的聯軸器,然後安裝自動變速箱 + 扭矩轉換器,或手動變速箱 + 離合器。配對錯誤或缺少配對件時,引擎仍能啟動,但不會有動力傳到車輪;油液不對或已髒污則會造成打滑、過熱並加速磨損。
Print_Media_MSC_VehiclePushingGuide_info: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD XIII^推動車輛<type:texture, x:100, y:200, texture:media/textures/MSC/printmedia_pushing_640.png, width:600, height:300><type:text, x:105, y:540, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>推動是移動拋錨或擋路車輛的應急辦法。車輛越重、角色越疲憊,所需的力氣就越大;體能越高,越能保存耐力。<type:text, x:105, y:680, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲中<type:text, x:105, y:725, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>離開空無一人且靜止的車輛,站在車頭或車尾,按右鍵選擇「推動車輛」,或使用已綁定的快捷鍵。力量達到 3 級只是解鎖此動作:力量越高,推力越強,消耗也越少;而體能則能降低耐力消耗。車輛越重越難推,提示框中會以「費力程度」顯示。體力耗盡時無法推動,短暫的恢復時間可防止連續狂按。
Print_Media_MSC_WorkshopRebuildGuide_inf: <type:parent, width:800, height:1000><type:texture, x:0, y:0, width:800, height:1000, r:0.73, g:0.69, b:0.57, a:1><type:texture, x:32, y:32, width:736, height:936, r:0.15, g:0.12, b:0.08, a:1><type:texture, x:38, y:38, width:724, height:924, r:0.88, g:0.85, b:0.74, a:1><type:text, x:75, y:78, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.72, scaleY:0.72, font:SdfOldBold>MASKARAD VII^重建與拆解回收<type:texture, x:100, y:200, texture:media/textures/MSC/printmedia_workshop_rebuild_640.png, width:600, height:300><type:text, x:105, y:540, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.38, scaleY:0.38, autoWidth:1500, font:SdfOldRegular>拆下的零件不一定是廢料。你可以將它拆解成對應的材料類別,或在保留其確切等級與維修紀錄的情況下進行重建。這讓工坊零件變得相當有價值。<type:text, x:105, y:680, r:0.28, g:0.18, b:0.08, a:1, scaleX:0.48, scaleY:0.48, font:SdfOldBold>遊戲內操作<type:text, x:105, y:725, r:0.12, g:0.08, b:0.04, a:1, scaleX:0.40, scaleY:0.40, autoWidth:1450, font:SdfOldRegular>對已拆下的零件,請使用其物品欄動作「拆解」或「修理」。拆解只接受狀態在 30% 以上的零件,並會將其轉為對應的材料類別;狀態越好,產出越多。重建需要工作檯面、光源、工具,以及兩份相符的材料。一般零件每次修理的效果都會遞減;傳奇零件則不會。
